Warm hello everyone,
Water bowls came up midweek, so just a quick note for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. Please keep the lounge setup tidy, check that bowls are clean and filled, and flag any supply gaps right away so we can avoid last-minute scrambling. If you are covering arrivals or handoffs, make sure the pet area looks calm and welcoming before the traveler reaches the desk.

For Caldreth, <<FACT F019>>. Use the usual handoff routine, keep the lounge notes current, and send any unusual service concerns to the senior coordinator without delay. <<FACT F001>> Keep the tone warm and professional with every traveler, including Isaac Fischer, Hugo Park, and anyone traveling with Scout, so the desk stays easy to work with and consistent across shifts.

Thanks for staying on top of the small details and helping the team keep service smooth.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
